Funk Royale

Funk Royale is a captivating six to eight-piece band that seamlessly blends pop, funk, and soul into an unforgettable musical experience.

About Funk Royale

Funk Royale is fronted by dynamic vocalists Kevin and Brooke , backed by a stellar lineup on guitar, keys, bass, drums, sax, and trumpet . Their shows burst with colour, soul, and charisma , fusing funk, pop, and soul anthems into one vibrant, dance-filled experience . Expect floor-fillers like Le Freak , Uptown Funk , Superstition , and Don’t Start Now —all performed with slick musicianship and magnetic stage presence. Kevin (he/they) is a soulful powerhouse, with roots in The Voice of Holland and West End shows like The Lion King . Brooke , a Brit School graduate, brings powerhouse vocals honed across Asia, Europe, and the UAE . Funk Royale’s musicians are top-tier professionals who’ve worked with Rod Stewart, Jools Holland , and played festivals worldwide. From bold brass lines to tight rhythms, they deliver show-stopping sets every time.
